comments.content: Things that have come out of a week where a remote team is finally occupying the same physical space: the Icon Wizard, a bunch of "snacktivities," at least one new hire, and a Hoobastank chorus that'll get stuck in your head just as you lay down to go to sleep. (Blame Ed.)

@supercodepoet.bsky.social 's best line from the episode: when your whole workday runs through a text interface, you lose context. Then you get together, remember these people are great, and rebuild it. "It's almost like we emotionally snuggle." 🤗
